name: anidoodle
description: Code-drawn stills, drawing timelapses, films, explainers and interactive web animations in 32 styles, with scores composed in code.

interface.longDescription: Illustrations, drawing timelapses, films of any length, explainers, infographics and interactive web animations in 32 hand-made styles, with original scores composed as data and played by an engine written in code. Match a style from your image, recreate a photo in any style, keep a character consistent, or learn how a drawing is built. Every render is deterministic, with no generated assets.
defaultPrompt: Show me the anidoodle styles and help me pick one for my landing page hero.
Draw a colored-pencil illustration of a fox in the snow, and a video of it being drawn.
Make a 60-second vertical explainer about how bees find flowers, with a score.
Recreate this photo as a Japanese woodblock print.
Teach me how to draw a cat sitting, step by step.
